Even if, the banned Contractor is an approved Sub-vendor under any Contract for such equ ipment/component/service, the Main Contractor shall not be permitted to place Work order/Purchase order/Service Contract on the banned Contractor as a sub-vendor after the date of banning even tho ugh the name of the party has been approved as a sub-vendor prior to the order of banning. 1.4.5. Banning shall automatically be extended to all Allied firms of the Contractor. The names of all partners should be clearly specified in the “Banning order”. 1.4.9. Banning in any manner does not impact any other contractual or other legal rights of NPCIL . 1.4.10.
